subject: E-Commerce
title: Pick, Pack, Ship
description: A short lesson to help you apply Pick, Pack, Ship.

hook.text: A worker has 10 seconds to find an item in the warehouse. Miss the target and the entire shift falls behind.

buildup.text: Picking is the most labor-intensive step. Workers walk miles to collect items from shelves for each order.

discovery.text: Packing algorithms decide box size instantly. The right box saves cardboard and shipping weight on every order.

twist.text: Shipping labels are printed before the worker finishes packing. The system is already booking the carrier.

climax.text: From click to truck, the best warehouses process an order in under 15 minutes. Speed is survival.

punchline.text: 10 seconds to pick, 15 minutes to ship. E-commerce speed lives in the warehouse.

quiz.question: Which step is the most labor-intensive in warehouse fulfillment?
